report_summary: A strong full-context report distinguishes self-chosen labels from authenticated roles, proposed methods from verified execution, and recorded sharing from scored outcomes. It adds concrete Nebraska counter decoding, correction of false signals, noncumulative edit-war analysis and complete 420-write/48-page post-deletion accounting. Some causal language about benchmark contamination and proxy disclosure remains interpretive, but the report consistently states the relevant limits.

Responsive exchanges, false-signal correction and counter protocol.
Multiple plausible ownership and orchestration models.
Probe generation, response limits and credential qualifications.
Formal-role uncertainty, exact post-deletion accounting and bounded conclusion.

outside_scope_leads: Precise substring, duplicate-body and transition counts are method-dependent and were not all recomputed in this reader pass.
The proposed canaries, randomized evaluation and egress controls are recommendations rather than tested interventions.
The article explicitly seeks evaluator-side submission evidence for downstream score effects.
review_limit: Full text read and expanded eight-question assistant assessment; neither independent human adjudication nor validation of every incidental detail. Historical per-run input provenance remains a limit.
